summary: Snake's up tilt (AttackHi3) is now G&W's up tilt on Pyra c06/c07 only, implemented end to end and audited offline. Four owned parts, no stand-ins: (1) plugin/src/acmd/snake_attack_hi3.rs is Snake's own game/effect/sound/expression_attackhi3 ported verbatim from the pinned donor text, registered on the same set_costume([6,7]) agent as every other override at Priority::High over the generated G&W AttackHi3; (2) src/pgwr/tools/build_snake_uptilt.py retargets Snake's c02attackhi3.nuanmb onto the built recipient skeleton (87 -> 77 transform nodes, 0 case-only matches, 10 dropped = FaceN + the nine S_Bandanna* nodes, 98 visibility nodes from the recipient idle, Material group dropped, 48 frames) and refuses to write a clip whose leg chain is static; (3) src/pgwr/build.py replaces the attack_hi3 motion-list entry with Snake's raw one whole (cancel frame 38, flags 0x84, game_script 0xef3bca119 = hash40('game_attackhi3')); (4) tools/merge_snake_uptilt_sound.py appends se_snake_attackhard_h01 to se_eflame_c06/c07, the four vc_snake_attack01..04 tones (measured out of the donor sequence record by CRC32, not listed by hand) to vc_eflame_c06/c07, and the seq_snake_rnd_attack record to eflame.sqb. AttackHi3 is a vanilla status kind, so no new status id is allocated and the next free Pyra id stays 0x208. THE ONE REAL OBSTACLE: the donor ACMD text the plan cited (dumps/scripts/SSBU-Dumped-Scripts-main/.../snake/AttackHi3.txt) does not exist in this tree - dumps/scripts holds only ParamLabels.csv and gamewatch_motion_list.yml, and the export paths.toml names is nearly empty. Approximating it is forbidden by rule 17, so the text was re-pinned from the commit this project already pins for exactly this purpose (WuBoytH/SSBU-Dumped-Scripts 59004685238a3f6f93bae905d3a4e079701c40b4, the commit behind refs/brave_special_n/acmd_pin.json and tools/fetch_donor_acmd.py) into refs/snake_attack_hi3/donor_acmd/ with per-file sha256, and R.O.B.'s AttackLw3.txt was pinned at the same commit as a control because the shipped acmd::robot_attack_lw3 was written from exactly that file - that comparison is what established how much the dump loses (R.O.B.'s loses braces and prints is_excute inside an else; Snake's AttackHi3 has no branch, no lost braces, no article call and no work-id write, so nothing was dropped). MEASURED, TIER B: plugin compiles with no errors in cache builds/.cache/pgwr-fb-2-snake-up-tilt-target, NRO 75deff8de447f8f4d171539d8791f046e5c190a60901b05b5ec9ddef809dc313 (466,944 B) carrying all four handler names, both sound names and both effect names; clip sha256 47133f4fb017c0fdc0416e9f169cdf7d3e710c10a724b14489041c13d52d4839 in both slots; the whole leg chain moves against the recipient idle (LegL 92.62 / LegR 78.01 / KneeL 97.79 / KneeR 80.55 / FootL 102.57 / FootR 54.40 degrees, ToeL 0.00 deg but 0.5895 units of translation, ToeR 7.06 deg / 0.5885 units), which is the R.O.B. down-tilt failure the user rejected and is now a gate rather than an assumption; sound banks retain 543 se / 240 vc baseline tones byte-for-byte (names, samples, tone records and labels all compared, with a negative control that deletes one appended tone and requires the check to reject it) and eflame.sqb retains 13 records and gains exactly one; the offline delta audit against the INSTALLED 0.20.17 passes with 18 changed files, 0 added, 0 removed, attack_hi3 the only motion-list entry differing in either slot, banks and sqb append-only, no c00-c05 Pyra file in the delta, and three negative controls verified to fire. NOT packaged and NOT installed by me (AGENTS rule 23). No console, no emulator, no automated test: everything about behaviour is tier D.

installer_notes: No new Cargo feature: the up tilt is unconditional, exactly like robot_attack_lw3 and littlemac_attack_s4, because build.py always writes its clip and sound merge. plugin/Cargo.toml already reads 0.20.18 (another agent bumped it for the Hero side-B Kazap work) - do not bump it again unless the combined version needs it. Three concurrent edits were made to src/pgwr/build.py; resolve them by hand if the other slots touched the same function (mine are all additive and marked 'Snake up tilt'). Exact steps, from mods/ssbu_mod_new, with MGW_EXPORT pointing at the full ArcExplorer export (it is absent here, so build.py could not be run in this session): (1) build the plugin ONCE from the finished combined tree, e.g. cd src/pgwr/plugin && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<mod repo>/builds/.cache/<your-cache> cargo skyline build --release --features snake-neutral-b,hero-side-b -- --offline . Do NOT ship my cache NRO 75deff8de447f8f4d171539d8791f046e5c190a60901b05b5ec9ddef809dc313: it was compiled while the other two slots were mid-edit, and copying several NROs is not a merge. (2) python src/pgwr/build.py  -> the per-slot build_motion record must contain a 'snake_uptilt' key with legs_all_moving true, bones_kept 77 and motion_entry.cancel 38, and the asset record must contain 'snake_uptilt_sound' with retained_tones 543 (se) and 240 (vc). The merge appends after merge_robot_dtilt_sound and writes snake_uptilt_sound.json into the package root, not the mod tree. (3) python tools/audit_snake_uptilt_delta.py --baseline 0.20.17 --version <new version> ; if the build also carries the other two slots' changes you MUST pass --combined "<describe them>", which requires the up-tilt set to be present and reports the rest instead of demanding an exact match (verified working that way). Expected: 18 changed files for this move alone; more with --combined. The NRO the audit checks is the one inside the package, so run it after staging. (4) Package with tools/package_pgwr_release.py as usual, then install with src/pgwr/install-to-card.sh (framework installation OFF), then tools/verify_installed_card.py. Expected mod-tree delta vs the card: the two c02attackhi3.nuanmb, the two eflame motion_list.bin, six se_eflame_c06/c07 bank files, six vc_eflame_c06/c07 bank files, sound/sequence/fighter/eflame.sqb, info.toml, and the new plugin NRO. Nothing under c00-c05 may appear. (5) Optional offline check that needs no package: python tools/merge_snake_uptilt_sound.py --check. (6) Optional reproduction of my audit without the export: python tools/stage_snake_uptilt_candidate.py --nro <the NRO you just built>, then point the audit at builds/.cache/fb-2-snake-up-tilt/0.20.18+snake-uptilt.1. The 18-file delta and the NRO handler/sound names are what my session actually observed; the audit passing against the real combined package is what still has to be run. Global logging stays OFF for this test (rule 11): this change is meant to ship on its own, and turning logging on would be a second state-changing change. No new status id, no config.json entry, no framework plugin touched, no SD-card write by me.
manual_checks: Vanilla control: Pyra c00 (and real Snake if the lab has one), plus the 0.20.17 G&W up tilt the user already knows. Global logging is off, so judge by eye and by the crash-report folder. 1. Boot fresh, open sd:/ultimate/pgwr_log.txt from boot. No new marker is expected; an [PGWR] BOOT line at all is normal background noise. 2. VANILLA CONTROL - Pyra c00, up tilt x5: must still be Pyra's own sword-flick up tilt, unchanged, with nothing resembling a kick. 3. Pyra c06, up tilt x5: must be a HIGH LEG KICK, no manhole, no G&W prop, with a blue arc sweep and turn smoke from above. Fail: G&W's old up tilt, or no kick. 4. Pyra c07, same x5: same kick and arc on the gold costume. 5. Timing: the move must stay out of hitstun recovery noticeably LONGER than 0.20.17's G&W up tilt (cancel frame 38). You must be able to act out of it around frame ~38 and not before. Fail: cancels far too early, or feels frozen. 6. Hit a training dummy: three boxes, ATTACK_REGION_KICK, arc effect on connect. Fail: no hit. 7. Sound: one Snake hard-attack hit sound plus a Snake attack grunt, and that grunt must NOT be Pyra's. Fail: silence or Pyra's up-tilt sound. 8. Rumble: a light nohitm rumble at the start and a distinct rbkind_attackm hit rumble at frame 6; it must feel like a kick, not like G&W's arm. 9. HITBOX PLACEMENT - the open question. Snake's script parents boxes on top / kneel / legl and none of the three is on the built c06/c07 skeleton (it has LegL/KneeL; top is a built-in anchor G&W's own up tilt already uses). This was left exactly as the donor wrote it, on purpose. PASS = the boxes sit at the kick. FAIL = boxes at the fighter's origin or nowhere sensible; if so, that is the single next change (remap kneel->KneeL, legl->LegL) and the ACMD module already says so. 10. Facing and slopes: kick left and right - both aim correctly relative to facing and the arc mirrors; kick on a slope - boxes stay on the ground side. 11. Regression sweep on c06 AND c07: jab, down tilt, forward smash, up-B Fire, side-B Monkey Flip, up air. All exactly as on 0.20.17; this change touches only attack_hi3, its clip and two banks. 12. Return sd:/ultimate/pgwr_log.txt from boot and any new sd:/atmosphere/crash_reports/ file. A crash = revert to 0.20.17 and report (rule 10).
unverified: How the kick looks on G&W's body (tier D) - no console, no emulator, no render. Only node coverage and leg-channel motion were measured offline.
Whether the legs read as a leg kick rather than a deformation (tier D).

Hitbox placement in game: top / kneel / legl do not exist on the built c06/c07 skeleton (measured), and the donor names were deliberately kept. Console step 9 decides it; if it fails, remapping kneel->KneeL and legl->LegL is the single next change.
That the tone and voice sequence actually play (tier D). Resolving a name to a label is not playback.
That the rumble and slope behaviour feel right (tier D).
That 38 frames is the right cancel in practice - it is Snake's own value taken whole, not a judged one.
Any regression in the other moves - the delta audit proves only which bytes changed, not how they feel.
